# Claim boundary

## Allowed after an engineering pass

> A frozen language model was successfully coupled to a trainable recurrent
> latent workspace, and the registered engineering checks passed.

## Allowed after state-use gates pass

> The learned latent state was causally useful on the registered late-binding
> task under no-injection and answer-incompatible shuffled-state interventions.

## Allowed after the feedback gate passes

> Recurrent model feedback was causally useful relative to the registered
> compute-matched within-model no-feedback ablation.

## Forbidden without later experiments

- A general Neuralese emerged.
- The model developed a private language.
- OSL was discovered inside the model.
- The system matches Astra.
- The system recursively improved itself.
- The system is aware, conscious, sentient, or a moral patient.

The package does not contain self-preservation rewards, unrestricted tool use,
network access, autonomous persistence, or external actuation.
